data.name: CivilianIndustriesContent
data.value: Emdad Company provides innovative solutions in petroleum materials and logistics services, including high-quality sustainable transportation technologies. The company works on supplying and providing petroleum companies with their required equipment and needs, such as fuel pumps, safety and occupational health equipment, fire trucks, all types of firefighting systems, water treatment and industrial wastewater treatment units, tanker trucks for transporting petroleum materials, and everything else petroleum companies may require.

data.name: EmdaadAimsContent
data.value:
Emdad strives to achieve leadership in providing integrated solutions across multiple sectors, ranging from defense industries to civil industries. We focus on delivering the latest products and technologies that align with technological advancements and meet both global and local market needs, while maintaining high standards of quality and innovation throughout all stages of production and distribution.
The "Emdaad" team has extensive experience in the defense industry, with partnerships with leading global and local companies. This allows us to offer the most advanced and cutting-edge solutions. We are also committed to applying the highest standards of quality and safety at every stage of production and supply.
